mapper.sql: id, tran_id, customer_id, vehicle_id, status, planned_delivery_time, actual_delivery_time, responsible_user_id, signer_name, signed_at, sign_method, sign_evidence, exception_type, exception_reason, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_delivery WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_delivery WHERE tran_id = #{tranId} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM t_delivery WHERE tran_id = #{tranId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_delivery ( tran_id, customer_id, vehicle_id, status, planned_delivery_time, actual_delivery_time, responsible_user_id, signer_name, signed_at, sign_method, sign_evidence, exception_type, exception_reason, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by ) VALUES ( #{tranId}, #{customerId}, #{vehicleId}, #{status}, #{plannedDeliveryTime}, #{actualDeliveryTime}, #{responsibleUserId}, #{signerName}, #{signedAt}, #{signMethod}, #{signEvidence}, #{exceptionType}, #{exceptionReason}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateTime}, #{updateBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_delivery SET status = 'COMPLETED', actual_delivery_time = #{actualDeliveryTime}, signer_name = #{signerName}, signed_at = #{signedAt}, sign_method = #{signMethod}, sign_evidence = #{signEvidence}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{currentStatus}

UPDATE t_delivery SET status = 'EXCEPTION', exception_type = #{exceptionType}, exception_reason = #{exceptionReason}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')

UPDATE t_delivery SET status = 'CANCELLED', exception_type = 'CANCELLED', exception_reason = #{reason}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
